summary.text: Mike Kushmerek is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 3rd Worcester District since January 2021 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia, which lists him as Michael Kushmerek, gives his education as a bachelor's degree from Fitchburg State University in 2008 and a graduate degree from Fitchburg State University in 2013, and his profession as executive.
Kushmerek took office on January 6, 2021, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Education and Economic Development and Emerging Technologies joint committees and served as vice chair of the Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy Joint Committee.
